resolvedStack: Next.js 14 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Prisma + NextAuth
name: MedFlow Clinic Scheduler
description: MedFlow Clinic Scheduler is a web platform for medical clinics to manage patient appointments, doctor shift availability, and clinical intake records with NextAuth authentication and PostgreSQL Prisma backend.

metadata.name: MedFlow Clinic Scheduler
metadata.description: Medical clinic appointment scheduling, doctor shifts, and patient intake SaaS.

files.description: Next.js 14, React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma 5, NextAuth v4, Zod, react-hook-form, date-fns, lucide-react.
PostgreSQL Prisma schema with Role, AppointmentStatus, Priority enums and User, Doctor, Patient, Appointment models.
Shared TypeScript interfaces for Doctor, Patient, Appointment.
Tailwind CSS base styles for clinical clean UI.
Root layout with SessionProvider, Navbar, main, and Footer.
Public landing page for MedFlow Clinic Scheduler with features and CTAs.
Clinic overview dashboard displaying daily appointments, doctor utilization, and urgent alerts.
Appointment schedule list and booking form with status filtering.
Doctors directory and shift availability cards.
Login form using NextAuth credentials provider.
Registration page posting to /api/register then signing in.
Client hook managing appointments from /api/appointments with safe array fallback.
Registration API creating hashed user in Prisma.
GET and POST API route for Appointment records with Zod validation.
GET and POST API route for Doctor availability.
